latest.description: Asset managers use S3 Versioning with Object Lock for immutable audit trails of factor inputs, Sharpe, IC, and backtest lineage. S3 Multi-Region Access Points, ParallelCluster, and ElastiCache pipelines ensure low-latency, scalable, risk-aware portfolio construction.

latest.title: Bulk Migrate Asymmetric Keys from AWS CloudHSM to AWS KMS
latest.description: Need to move hundreds or thousands of asymmetric keys from AWS CloudHSM to AWS KMS? AWS documents how to migrate a single key, but offers no systematic way to do it at scale. This guide introduces an open-source toolkit of scripts that discovers, batches, migrates, and verifies RSA and ECC keys in bulk, while ensuring private key material never leaves the HSM in plaintext. The scripts have already been used to migrate more than 3,000 keys.

This step-by-step guide walks you through the setup on a Mac—keeping your prompts and per-token billing within AWS, with no separate OpenAI sign-in.

latest.title: Automating Internal Vulnerability Scanning in AWS with Nessus Manager, Lambda, Secrets Manager, and EventBridge Scheduler
latest.description: This article walks through a real AWS lab for automating internal vulnerability scans with Nessus Manager, AWS Lambda, AWS Secrets Manager, and Amazon EventBridge Scheduler. It explains why standalone Nessus Professional can list scans through the API, while the scan launch endpoint is available only in Nessus Manager. It then shows how to securely store API credentials, connect Lambda to the private scanner, schedule scan triggers, and validate results using metrics, logs, and scan results.

latest.title: How to connect CUR data via Athena to Quick in a cross-account environment
latest.description: This guide shows how to aggregate AWS Cost and Usage Report (CUR) data across multiple accounts and analyze it in QuickSight—for reseller users who can't create CUR in their Payer account. Steps: export CUR to S3 via Data Exports (CFn StackSets), create an Athena workgroup, Glue crawler/tables, and a UNION view in an aggregation account, then connect cross-account from QuickSight using IAM switch roles and Boto3. A key use case: tracking per-user Amazon Bedrock (Claude) costs via IAM principal email.

trending.description:
ASET (Academic Safety and Evidencing Truth) is a scientific claim verification engine built  for the AI era — where information can be generated instantly, but trust cannot, to address the growing problem of hallucinated citations and  AI-generated information.
